Class StripeServiceTest

@IsTest
private class StripeServiceTest

Test class for StripeService. Validates methods for processing Stripe transaction files, linking transactions to payments, and assigning references to transaction records.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void assignReferencesTest1()

Tests the AssignReferences queueable job with specific transaction IDs. Verifies that TransactionReference and StripeReference records are created correctly for customer, card, and transfer references.

@IsTest
private static void assignReferencesTest2()

Tests the AssignReferences queueable job using days ago parameter. Verifies that TransactionReference and StripeReference records are created correctly for transactions created within the specified number of days.

@IsTest
private static void getStripeBalanceTransactionsErrorTest1()

Tests error handling in the GetStripeBalanceTransactions queueable job. Verifies that errors during balance transaction retrieval are logged correctly and that the Fee__c field remains null on StripeTransaction__c records.

@IsTest
private static void getStripeBalanceTransactionsErrorTest2()

Tests error handling in the GetStripeBalanceTransactions queueable job for HTTP errors. Verifies that errors during balance transaction retrieval are logged correctly and that the Fee__c field remains null on StripeTransaction__c records.

@IsTest
private static void getStripeBalanceTransactionsTest()

Tests the GetStripeBalanceTransactions queueable job. Verifies that the Fee__c field on StripeTransaction__c records is updated correctly based on the retrieved balance transaction data from Stripe.

@IsTest
private static void linkStripeTransactionsToPaymentsTest1()

Tests the LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments queueable job. Verifies that Stripe transactions are correctly linked to their associated Payment records and vice versa based on PaymentIntentId.

@IsTest
private static void linkStripeTransactionsToPaymentsTest2()

Tests the LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments queueable job using days ago parameter. Verifies that Stripe transactions are correctly linked to their associated Payment records and vice versa based on PaymentIntentId.

@IsTest
private static void processTransactionsExceptionTest()

Tests exception handling when processing a Stripe transactions CSV file with invalid data. Verifies that the process catches and properly reports exceptions during file processing.

@IsTest
private static void processTransactionsFileEmptyTest()

Tests processing of an empty Stripe transactions CSV file (headers only, no data). Verifies that the process fails gracefully and returns appropriate error message.

@IsTest
private static void processTransactionsFileErrorsTest()

Tests processing of a Stripe transactions CSV file with records containing errors. Verifies that the process handles partial failures correctly and tracks errors appropriately.

@IsTest
private static void processTransactionsFileSuccessfulTest()

Tests successful processing of a Stripe transactions CSV file with multiple records. Verifies that all transactions are imported correctly and fees are calculated properly, including negative numbers.

@IsTest
private static void syncStripeChargesErrorTest()

Tests the SyncStripeCharges queueable job. Verifies that errors during charge retrieval are logged correctly and that no StripeTransaction__c records are created.
